dedupe_keys.name: farmos farm management and record keeping

description: farmOS is a web-based application for farm management, planning and record keeping, intended as a standard platform for collecting and managing agricultural data such as fields, plantings, animals, equipment and the activities and observations logged against them. It is developed by a community of farmers, developers, researchers and organisations, with code in the farmOS GitHub organisation and a community forum, chat and regular development calls. It is generic and used worldwide on farms of different kinds. It is built on the Drupal content management framework, which makes it modular and extensible, and it is free and open source under the GNU General Public License; users can host it themselves following the installation guide or use a hosting provider listed in the hosting guide. Caveats: it records what farm managers enter, not generating data, so coverage and quality depend on each farm, and the home page read does not list current versions or supported data standards. For simulation it provides structured farm records, from plantings to inputs and harvests, that can feed crop, livestock and farm digital twin models and supply data on how farm operations respond to disruptions. It is related to the Climate FieldView record in this catalogue, a commercial farm data platform.
